content: Isar foila sahabi okkol
Ek šome Isa Gennesaret halor farot tiyaiye. Heṛe manuš okkole Isattu Allar kalam funibolla ṭelaṭeli goijje.
Isaye sadde halor hãsat duiyan no ase, kintu zailla okkole henttu lami zai zal duwer.
Henot oi duiyan nor butottu, Isaye Simonor not uiṭṭe. Ar hitare nogan kulottu ekkena dure loi zaibolla hoiye. Toi Isaye not boi manuš okkolore šikka diya šuru goijje.
Isaye hota howa šeš gori bade hibaye Simonore hodde,

content.text: "Tui tor noganore entu maze loi za, ar mas saibolla tor zal felagoi."

content: Simone hodde, "Ustad, ãra šara rait mehennot gori kissu no fai, tarfore o õne zehon hor, ãi zal felaiyum."
Hitara zal felaiye bade en masor ḍõr zãk dora foijje, zenneki hitarar zal udda siri zaitoi saiye.

Henot hitarar šiyardar okkol zara oinno not ase, hitarare o hate išara gori ḍaikke, zene hitara aiyore itarare modot gori fare. Hitara aiyore duiyan no en bafe mas loi botti goijje, zene no duniyan dufi zaibar alamot oiye.
Ei hanḍo deki Simon, zare Fitor hoi o ḍake, hite Isar sarme uite fori hodde, "Malik õne ãr hãsottu zogoi, ãi gunagar."
Kiyollahoile zalot eto mas dora foijje, Simon edde hitar sãti okkol beggune tajjuf oiye,
ar hendilla ekkui bafe Simonor šiyardar, Sebudiyusor fuwain Yakub edde Yuhanna o tajjuf oiye. Hetunot Isaye Simonore hodde,

content.text: "No ḍorais, ehon loti tui manuš doribi."

content: Tarfore hitara hitarar nogunore kulor uwore tuli felaiyore, hár kissu felai raki Isar fisa loiye.
Ek kurus biyaraimma

Isaye ek bar ek šohorot giye. Heṛe ekzon kurus biyaraimma manuš aššil, zar hara ga gáye furaiya aššil. Isare deki he manušwaye meṛir uzu oi uite fori Isattu duwa sai hodde, "Malik, õne issa gorile ãre bala gori fariba."
Isaye hat ṭani hitare suiyore hodde,
Ar hehon hitar kurus biyaram bala oi giyegoi.
Isaye hitare endilla hokum diye,

content.text: "Ei hota honokiyore no hois, bolke zaiyore dórmiyo Alem okkolore dehagoi, toi bade saf oi faijjosde hiyanolla Musar ain mozin ekkan kurbani gorgoi. Henot mainšor hãse tui foriškar oiosde hiyanor forman oibo."

content: Tarfore o Isar hóbor aro beši sorai giyegoi. Isar hota funibolla edde biyaraimma okkol aram oibolla bout manuš okkol Isar hãse aiya šuru goijje.
Kintu Isaye hamiša nirzon zagat zai duwa gorito.
Ek leng manuš
Ek din Isaye šikka der, hen šomot Foroši

okkol edde dórmiyo alem okkol Isar hãse ai boiššegai. Hitara aššilde Galil edde Ehudiya elehar bout fara okkolor edde Zeruzalem šohoror manuš okkol. Biyaraimma aram goribolla Mabudor šokti Isattu aššil.
Hetunot hoekzon mainše ekzon leng biyaraimmare haiṭṭa loi bar gori ainne. Hitara hitare butore loi zaiyore Isar sarme rakito saiye.
Kintu zamila buli hitare butore loizaibar fõt no fa. Hetunot hitara góror salor uwore uiṭṭe edde salor sani hana gori bisana šo hitare manuš okkolor maze Isar sarme lamai diye.
Isaye hitarar biššaš dekiyore hodde,
Henot dórmiyo alem edde Foroši okkole mone mone bafa šuru goijje, "Ite honnuwa, ze Allare ofoman gorer? Allah sara ar honokiye guna maf gori di no fare!"
Hitara mone mone ki sinta goijje Isaye buzi fariyore hodde:

content.text: Tor guna maf gora oiye howa asan oibo ne naki tui uṛi ãṛi bera howa asan oibo?
Kintu duniyait guna maf gori dibar kemota Adomor Futottu ase, hiyan zene tũwara zani faro."

content: Hen hoi Isaye he leng manušwar mikka firi hitare hodde,

content.text: "Ãi tore hoir, uṭ, tor bisanagan tuli loi górot zagoi."

content: Ar manušwa hehon beggunor sarme tiyaiye edde hite neṛi aššilde bisanagan tuli loiye, edde Allare šukuriya gori gori górot giyegoi.
Henot beggune kub tajjuf oiye edde Allare šukuriya zanaiye. Ar hitarattu Allar ḍor góille edde hodde, "Aijja ãra ki tajjuiffa ham dekilam!"
Ekzon Levire Isaye ḍaikke
Tarfore Isa henttu niyoli giyegoi edde dekedde Levi name ekzon hazna adaigoroya, hite hazna tulede zagat boi taikke. Isaye Levire hodde,
Toi hite o uiṭṭe edde hitar hár kissu felai raki Isar fisa loiye.
Bade Levi manušwaye hitar górot Isalla ek ḍõr hána goijje. Heṛe aro bout hazna adaigoroya okkol edde aro bout manuš okkol šoho hitarar fũwati hána haito boišše.
Hetunot heṛe aššilde Foroši okkol edde hitarar dórmiyo alem okkole Isar sahabi okkolore nališ gori hodde, "Tũwara hazna adaigoroya edde gunagar okkol loi kiyolla há fiya goro?"
Kintu zuwabe Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Araimma mainšottu ḍakṭoror dorhar nai, kintu biyaraimma mainšottu dorhar ase.
Ãi forhesgar okkolore no, kintu gunagar okkolore ḍakito aiššide, zene hitara gunattu mon fira."

content: Ruzar babute suwal
Toi hitara hibare hodde, "Yahyar šagirit okkole hamiša ruza rake edde munazat gore, Foroši okkolor šagirit okkole o hen gore, kintu õnor sahabi okkole há fiya gorat take."
Isaye hitarare hodde:

content.text: "Dula fũwati taite dular fũwajja okkolore ki tũwara ruza rakai fariba?
Kintu en šomoi aiyer, zẽtte hitarar hãsottu dulare loi za oibo, ar he din okkolot hitara ruza rakibo."

content: Hibaye hitarare ekkan mesal kahani o hoiye:

content.text: "Noya kurutattu ṭura siri honokiye furan kurutat tali no laga. Kiyollahoile, hen gorile to noya kurutawa siri fela o. Ar he noya taligan o furan kurutar fũwati no mana.
Otóba honokiye no ḍale tottoza šoraf furan samorar hoillat. Kiyollahoile ḍalile he tottoza šorafgune hoillagunore fuṛai felaibo, henot šorafgun o goli zaiboi edde hoillaguno o nošto oi zaiboi.
No, tottoza šoraf noya samor hoillat raka foribo.
Furan šoraf hái bade honokiye tottoza šoraf haito no sa, kiyollahoile hite hoibo, 'Furangun bala beši.'"
